proofUses.reason: Fixed-interval Brownian reversal identifies the reverse map with the centered inverse map. This is an identity in law at each fixed time, not a process identity in the time parameter.

The ratio diffusion is globally nonexplosive in height time, so every finite target height is reached in finite physical time in the chosen direction. Integrating the exact log-derivative formula gives the two-sided comparison needed to repair the source lower-bound proof.

The height-clock martingale has uniformly bounded stochastic coefficient on finite clock intervals. This proves the weighted moment identity for every real b and either flow direction, at any target height.
Bounded height-clock stopping and Schwarz–Pick give an explicit power bound. It has the source powers and removes its logarithmic loss when a=lambda; the source upper bound remains valid.

Dyadic Borel–Cantelli, Koebe distortion and integration yield local Holder extension to the boundary for each fixed deterministic time. The choice b=kappa^(-1/2) gives positive exponents except at kappa4 and the source limiting exponents at zero and infinity. No joint-time or trace-generation conclusion is inferred.
